g.text: WHAT A VISIT STARTS. NO CRON: WORK RUNS ONLY WHILE SOMEONE USES THE APP
A visit wakes the sleeping Render instance.
One task reads fetch_log and finds work past next_due.
Refreshes run on a fixed pool of 2 threads.
An advisory lock stops a second fetch of the same key.
An empty source budget skips that layer, as if it were down.
The waterfall writes rows and progress to Postgres.
A request checks the stored row first.
Stale but inside max stale: serve now, queue a refresh.
Price of the design: the first visitor
after a long idle may see data with
a stale flag for about a minute.

Built on first view of that page.
so they load on first view.
when a stress scenario needs them.
BUDGET: about 70 Tiingo symbols of 500 a month, about 120 SEC calls, about 55 Finnhub calls. About 180k price rows, under 100 MB.
